description.value: A renovated, centrally located motel in downtown Kelowna operating under the Choice Hotels banner, with 108 suites and guest rooms across a two-storey building. Touring cyclists will find it notable for its dedicated bicycle storage locker — an explicit listed amenity — alongside an indoor pool, hot tub, and an on-site restaurant. Its position on Harvey Avenue places it close to the Okanagan Lake waterfront and Kelowna's urban cycling network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at econolodgekelowna.com is live and fully corroborates the OSM address, phone, and email. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Bicycle storage locker' confirming secure bike storage. Additional amenities confirmed from the site include self-serve laundry, free light breakfast, an on-site restaurant (Mekong), high-speed wireless internet, and EV charging stations; staff bike-procedure knowledge and several other amenities are not mentioned. The OSM name 'Econo Lodge Kelowna' differs from the website's consistent branding of 'Econo Lodge Inn and Suites', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the property as 'Econo Lodge Kelowna' but the website consistently uses 'Econo Lodge Inn and Suites' as the trading name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a dedicated bike storage locker — a strong candidate for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: EV charging stations are listed as an amenity on the website; these are likely car-oriented and are not counted as e-bike charging without further confirmation.
